odd_even_process_pairs.even_uncertainty_reduced: Reduced. Verified and recorded: (a) the candidate's per-segment median log returns are essentially unchanged by the repository's realistic cost model and by 2x that cost (max |change| 0.001 base, 0.002 stress2x, all <= 0.005 tol) and every zero-cost edge asset remains positive at both cost levels for lookbacks 3/5/10 -> COST_ROBUST in absolute terms; (b) the coin-flip null is cost-unfair (pays ~26-29x the candidate's commission; goes negative at 2x cost), so the framework's candidate-minus-null comparison is confounded under costs and its edge-count preservation is not valid cost-robustness evidence; (c) independent verification (4 gates) and the 168-test regression suite pass.
